notes:
SyCOMPART is now available.

## Highlights

- **SyCOMPART**: a full compartment modeling module — script-based mesh creation (Python-like syntax), a mesh inspector, layer-based organization, multi-select operations, and drag-in mesh boxes.
- **Stability criteria evaluation**: IMO Res. A.749(18) intact stability criteria and MARPOL/ICLL deterministic damage stability criteria, each with automatic pass/fail results, openings, and deck-edge immersion checks.
- **Shell thickness modeling**: reduction/filling loading factors per compartment, and Volume-Extreme vs. Volume-Molded hydrostatics that account for shell thickness.
- **HULL**: smoother, dynamically updating Cp curve (reflects the actual station set, including out-of-range stations), a Cp curve detail popup with CPA/CPF and body plan, and DXF export with proper TrueType (Arial) text instead of the default stroke font.
- Shared camera controls and view tools between the HULL and COMPART 3D views.

## Notes

- This release covers the HULL and COMPART modules. DIMENSION is not included in this build.
- Windows only in this release; the macOS build will follow separately.
